subject: New lavaan Seminars and Structured Program

messages.subject: New lavaan Seminars and Structured Program
parts:
Hi everyone
I wanted to let you know about some new lavaan seminars that I'm running in August through the Institute for Statistical and Data Science (Instats), including a 'structured program' called From Regression to Longitudinal and Multilevel SEM in R that includes 4 of these seminars packaged together. As always at Instats, PhD students get very large discounts and the structured program provides a 10% discount on all of the seminars.

One thing I've noticed -- and you may have noticed as well? -- is that many researchers use lavaan for single-level modeling but do not seem to be fully utilizing lavaan's two-level modeling capabilities. There are some limitations of course compared to Mplus, but for a free R package the two-level models in lavaan can be quite powerful. The last seminar in the series on Multilevel SEM in lavaan directly addresses this important capability of lavaan.

In case it's of interest, I also offer free weekly Office Hours that often cover lavaan for anyone (especially PhD students) with questions about it. For example see this week's on Longitudinal Data Models and next week that includes BSEM in blavaan.

Any help in spreading the word about what we're doing at Instats would be most appreciated!

Best wishes and thank you for this wonderful community!

Michael Zyphur
Director
Institute for Statistical and Data Science
instats.com.au
